parsed.summary: The KiCad netlist matches the specification for the m5-pantilt board: power diodes D1/D2 are oriented correctly, the battery high-side switch path (J5/Q1/R5/SW1), MAX3485 UART/auto-direction circuit (U1/Q2/R1/R2/R6/R7/R8/R15), PWM jumper selection (R9-R12), and serial bus jumpers (R13/R14) are all connected as described. No functional deviation supported by the files was found.
